description.p: LGL Simple Colour Picker is a small Qt 6 desktop utility for sampling a colour from the screen and copying it in ready-to-paste HEX, RGB, and RGBA formats.
Version 1.0.1 keeps the MVP feature set and adds lifecycle cleanup for portal requests, helper processes, and overlays.

ul.li: Cleaned up active portal requests, helper processes, and overlays on shutdown.
Added bounded timeouts for interactive helper processes.
Addressed Qt static-analysis feedback for compositor-output parsing.
Initial v1.0.0 MVP with screen picking, preview, clipboard copy, and transparent app icons.
